# Task 5 migrates the script callers onto scripts/resolve-root.sh. Every probe
# it changes, with the correction owning the change: the repo-root override is
# honoured only when it names a git toplevel (a caller that means "no repo-side
# layer" now says PLANWRIGHT_REPO_ROOT=none), and a dispatch from a worktree
# places the task worktree under the primary checkout.
@@ overlay-repo-root-override primary repo-root-narrowing
planwright: refusing PLANWRIGHT_REPO_ROOT='<PRIMARY>/specs': it does not name the toplevel of a git working tree
rc=0
@@ overlay-repo-root-override worktree repo-root-narrowing
planwright: refusing PLANWRIGHT_REPO_ROOT='<WORKTREE>/specs': it does not name the toplevel of a git working tree
rc=0
@@ dispatch-worktree worktree worktree-placement
fleet-dispatch-worktree: NOTE: no remote reachable; basing on local main (degraded, D-9)
dispatch	branch	planwright/demo/task-1
dispatch	worktree	<PRIMARY>/.claude/worktrees/demo-task-1
dispatch	base	<SHA>
rc=0
